title: Relationship Facet -- relationships.yaml
description: SDD-R011 §8, SDD-R003 Universal Relationship Model. The source of every entry is implicit -- the owning Engineering Knowledge Object (SDD-R010 §6: relationships are authored per-object, one file per object, listing only relationships where that object is the source). As of WORK_PACKAGE_002, the shape follows SDD-R011 §8 exactly (relationship_id, relationship_type, target, cardinality, lifecycle, confidence, notes) -- the WORK_PACKAGE_001 fields `category`, `metadata`, `behavior`, and a nested `provenance`/`version` were dropped; see docs/SCHEMA_MIGRATION.md.

relationship_type.description: SDD-R011 §8 / SDD-R003 §8. Checked against the known Relationship Type list by the validator (soft, extensible).

target.description: Object ID of the target Engineering Knowledge Object (SDD-R003 §7).

lifecycle.description: SDD-R011 §8 -- the relationship's own maturity, independent of either endpoint's lifecycle_state.

notes.description: SDD-R011 §8. Documentation only -- never authoritative for validation (use `constraints` for that).

constraints.description: REFERENCE-TASK-000014 structured constraints this relationship imposes (SDD-R003 §12).
